texture.name: Prague Texture Segmentation Benchmark
texture.fit: Best match for the paper's texture experiments: benchmark texture mosaics with corresponding ground-truth and mask images.
texture.license_note: Use only files allowed by the benchmark terms; keep downloaded archives local unless license-safe.

medical.name: BrainWeb Simulated Brain MRI Database
medical.fit: Stable MRI-like source with simulated volumes and anatomical labels; suitable for grayscale multiclass segmentation before using heavier clinical datasets.
medical.license_note: Verify BrainWeb terms before redistributing; prefer keeping raw volumes local.

medical.name: TCIA Pretreat-MetsToBrain-Masks
medical.fit: Real brain MRI segmentations, but much larger and tumor/metastasis-specific; useful after BrainWeb.
medical.license_note: Large clinical archive; check TCIA usage and citation requirements before committing derived assets.

cartoon.name: Berkeley Segmentation Dataset and Benchmark
cartoon.fit: Natural-image public substitute with human segmentations; useful for smooth-region / cartoon-like qualitative checks, but not the original paper cartoon data.
cartoon.license_note: Use according to Berkeley dataset terms; keep original archives local unless redistribution is permitted.

cartoon.name: Weizmann Segmentation Evaluation Database
cartoon.fit: Small natural-image segmentation database with ground truth; useful as backup if BSDS setup is inconvenient.
cartoon.license_note: Research-use disclaimer and image-source terms are restrictive; do not commit images without review.
